title: GI 301 – Further Topics in General Insurance

topics.title: Stochastic Reserving
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to use stochastic loss development models to estimate reserve variability.

outcomes.text: Identify the assumptions underlying the chain ladder estimation method.
Test for the validity of these assumptions.
Identify alternative models that should be considered depending on the results of the tests.
Estimate the standard deviation of a chain ladder estimator of unpaid claims.
Apply a parametric model of loss development.
Estimate the standard deviation of a parametric estimator of unpaid claims.
Assess whether a fitted model is acceptable given the data being modeled.

topics.title: Risk Margins for Unpaid Claims
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the considerations in selecting a risk margin for unpaid claims.

outcomes.text: Describe a risk margin analysis framework.
Identify the sources of uncertainty underlying an estimate of unpaid claims.
Describe methods to assess this uncertainty.

topics.title: Specialized Ratemaking Topics
topics.objective: The candidate will understand and be able to apply ratemaking techniques for the following situations: classification ratemaking, deductible options, increased limit options, claims-made policies and individual risk rating.

outcomes.text: Understand and apply classification ratemaking methods.
Explain the issues and considerations regarding classification ratemaking.
Price for deductible options and increased limits.
Develop rates for claims-made contracts.
Understand and apply techniques for individual risk rating.
Estimate the premium asset for retrospectively rated policies.

topics.title: Reinsurance
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the fundamentals of reinsurance and demonstrate knowledge of reinsurance reserving, the fundamental techniques of reinsurance pricing and risk transfer testing of reinsurance contracts.

outcomes.text: Understand the types of reinsurance and key reinsurance terms.
Explain the principal functions of reinsurance.
Analyze and describe the various types of reinsurance.
Understand the issues encountered when applying loss development methods to reinsurance.
Calculate the price of a reinsurance contract.
Apply an aggregate distribution model to a reinsurance pricing scenario.
Describe considerations involved in pricing property catastrophe covers.
Understand the application of a reinstatement premium.
Test for risk transfer in reinsurance contracts.

resources.citation: Fundamentals of General Insurance Actuarial Analysis, Friedland, J., 2nd Edition, SOA, 2022

Understand how catastrophe model output can be used in actuarial tasks.
Allocate a property catastrophe risk load among different accounts.
